title: Parallel decompression of gzip-compressed files and random access to DNA sequences
relevance: Foundational paper for parallel gzip decompression via speculative block boundary detection. Introduced pugz, achieving 10x over gunzip and 5x over libdeflate.

title: Rapidgzip: Parallel Decompression and Seeking in Gzip Files Using Cache Prefetching
relevance: Generalized pugz's approach to arbitrary binary data using a cache-and-prefetch architecture. Achieved 8.7 GB/s with 128 cores.

title: Massively-Parallel Lossless Data Decompression
relevance: Proposed GPU-based parallel DEFLATE decompression achieving 2x speedup over CPU libraries. Introduced techniques to eliminate data dependencies within blocks.

title: Challenging the 'embarrassingly sequential': parallelizing finite state machine-based computations through principled speculation
relevance: Theoretical foundation for speculative FSM parallelization, directly applicable to Huffman decoding as an FSM.
